newsitem.title: singapore: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 20.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices fell as sellers lowered their prices to capture business from South Korea. Sources said as demand was thin sellers were forced to cut their prices in order to secure the orders. One major said several 380-cst lots were sold to shipowners, including Korean vessels, at $100.50-$101.50 per tonne. 180-cst traded at around $108 per tonne for a small lot.
